**Finding: Compliant (no redline).**

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding the Company. I checked Section 5.4 (General Manager appointments — the planner's likely parking spot), Section 6 (exclusivity), Section 8 (confidentiality) and Section 10 (general provisions), and ran searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire" and "induce". The only hits are incidental: HDI's employees in the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and the independent-contractor/no-agency language (p0061).

This lands at our **preferred** position — no non-solicit on the Customer — so nothing to negotiate here. Two notes for the file:
- Section 6.1 does restrict the Company (similar-project exclusivity), but that is a commercial exclusivity covenant, not a personnel restriction, and is addressed under the exclusivity rule rather than double-flagged here.
- Section 6.3 restricts HDI for two years post-expiration; that runs in our favour and is not flagged.
